note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled Thursday 2 June 1955 in two divisions (Dunminning and Kells). All 23 divisions are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (Form No. 23; Ballymena Observer, 10 June 1955, p. 9): candidates, votes where a poll was taken, persons elected and retiring members deemed re-elected (Cromkill, Glenravel, Lisnagarron and Longmore). No party labels are printed; places of abode are not reproduced. The notice spells two divisions Glenraville and Glenwhirry; the usual spellings are used here. Returned unopposed.
